definitions.explanation: A silvery fish of the northern seas, once caught in huge numbers off Hokkaido. Its roe is {数|かず}の{子|こ}, a New Year food.

examples.japanese: ニシン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{塩焼|しおや}き→塩焼き：12120_shioyaki⟧。
⟦{数|かず}の{子|こ}→数の子：30539_kazunoko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ニシン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧だ。

⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧、⟦{北海道|ほっかいどう}→北海道：11010_hokkaidou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ニシン⟦{漁|りょう}→漁：31785_ryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧で、ニシン⟦{御殿|ごてん}→御殿：24076_goten⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{屋敷|やしき}→屋敷：12395_yashiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}てられた→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: Herring fishing once flourished in Hokkaido, and large mansions called "herring palaces" were built from its profits.

notes:
Usually written in katakana; the kanji spellings are {鰊|にしん} and {鯡|にしん}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ニシンそば: soba topped with sweet-simmered herring, a Kyoto specialty
- {身欠|みが}きニシン: dried split herring
- ニシン⟦{漁|りょう}→漁：31785_ryou⟧: herring fishing

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{数|かず}の{子|こ}→数の子：30539_kazunoko⟧: herring roe, eaten at New Year as a wish for many children
